note: Fifteen evaluation criteria maintained in this repository for comparing the three approaches. The questions and slot mappings define the analysis scope.

criteria.name: Triad fidelity
criteria.question: Does the option keep regulator, implementer and assessor roles separable?

criteria.name: Normativity
criteria.question: Can the artifact express must versus may? Can an auditor treat it as binding?

criteria.name: Requirement level
criteria.question: Can shall, should and may be represented at all?

criteria.name: Hierarchy support
criteria.question: Does the model natively carry deep benchmark hierarchies?

criteria.name: Tailoring
criteria.question: Can an organization select, exclude and parameterize at scale?

criteria.name: Authoring burden
criteria.question: How many OSCAL artifacts must a benchmark author produce per benchmark, multiplied across roughly 100 CIS guides?

criteria.name: SSP impact
criteria.question: How many additional items enter the SSP? Does the SSP end up mixing desired and actual state?

criteria.name: Response fidelity
criteria.question: Can a system owner answer per host or inventory item, or only per component?

criteria.name: Traceability
criteria.question: Can a consumer traverse control to rule to check to activity to task to observation using core schema only?

criteria.name: Schema change cost
criteria.question: How many models change, and what is the realistic ratification timeline?

criteria.name: Update decoupling
criteria.question: When a benchmark revises independently of the regulation, what has to change downstream?

criteria.name: Cross-framework use
criteria.question: Does this help someone operating under SOC 2, ISO and FedRAMP at the same time?

criteria.name: Inspectability
criteria.question: Can an operator see what a check does before running it on their systems?

criteria.name: Prop dependence
criteria.question: How much meaning lives in namespaced props rather than core schema?

criteria.name: Existing content
criteria.question: Is there working end-to-end content today, including an SSP and an AR?
